purpose: Evidence-only semantic inventory before the D0031 self-development documentation architecture Design. This record does not itself change authority.

findings.finding: The file declares group/e-context-delivery as the active cumulative checkpoint branch even though current repository authority and the observed remote active branch are group/f-cloudflare-runtime.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Preserve its unique historical rationale as history; move current lineage authority to a single current normative owner.

findings.finding: Active/completed Group and branch facts are repeated across stable rules, workflow, program and routing documents.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: WORKBOARD should own the current routing instance; lineage/workflow documents should own stable transition rules without duplicating the current instance.

findings.finding: The required-reading list forces many self-development and program documents into every change before affected scope is known.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Use a small fixed bootstrap kernel and progressive loading selected by current routing and affected owners.

findings.finding: The current router is followed by verified history from D0015 back through D0002 and a resulting-foundation narrative.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Keep only carry-forward facts that constrain present routing; retain detailed history in Design/evidence/history owners.

findings.finding: The 1099-line report is an append-only historical verification aggregate whose early sections correctly describe formerly active Group E states but visually resembles a current ALLCAPS normative owner.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Freeze/demote as a lowercase historical record; do not rewrite its historical observations as current state.

findings.finding: A completed Group E-specific execution contract remains in the ALLCAPS normative development namespace while no Group F equivalent exists.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Preserve as lowercase history rather than perpetuating a Group-specific required-document class.

findings.finding: The durable invariant is the distinction between plane health, route health and current-session capability; most of the document is a Termux/tmcp-specific elaboration of WORKFLOW semantics.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Merge the durable invariant into WORKFLOW if no unique owner conflict is found; retain tool-specific examples only as supporting history/guide if still useful.

findings.finding: MVP.md is a widely referenced normative executable-acceptance owner but also accumulates historical verification counts and evidence narrative.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Retain the stable normative path initially; reduce historical accumulation only after proving every retained acceptance rule and reference owner. Renaming to QUALIFICATION is not justified by naming value alone.

findings.finding: ALLCAPS currently mixes live normative owners with completed/specific/historical records, weakening filename semantics.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Reserve ALLCAPS for live normative/current owners, with README as a conventional exception; use lowercase-kebab for bounded Design/evidence/history/specific records.

findings.finding: SDD says a failed falsifier reopens a Design or owner, but reopened and amended/revision are absent from the formal status/lifecycle model; D0019 already demonstrates an accepted-as-amended practice.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Formalize revision, reopen, supersede and downstream invalidation without making rollback the default correction mechanism.

findings.finding: Historical records contain exact former document paths and branch identities that are part of provenance.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: Do not blindly rewrite evidence/historical path strings during naming migration; current live references and intentionally maintained records must be distinguished from immutable historical observations.

findings.finding: Existing Design files are D0001-D0019 and D0030; no D0031 file or planning entry was found in the bounded current program/design search.
findings.dispositionHypothesis: D0031 is available for the self-development documentation architecture decision, subject to the Design itself recording that it is a cross-cutting self-development/risk gate rather than a new product capability.

preservationRules: Do not delete historical rationale merely because its former current pointer is stale.
Do not rewrite exact evidence observations to make them look current.
Do not create a new permanent meta-document for every derived session concept when an existing owner can carry the invariant.
Do not rename a widely referenced normative owner unless the semantic and reference-migration benefit exceeds the churn risk.
A fact remaining old but still constraining current work, such as a rollback barrier or inherited qualification gap, remains eligible for compact WORKBOARD carry-forward.
toolingNote: Two independent agy harness attempts were not used as evidence because tmcp rejected their completion without an exact external session ID (HARNESS_SESSION_ID_MISSING).
